name: NAC™: Advanced Routing Package
description:
Sometimes, basic automation isn't enough. We've heard you - we are now offering the §5§nAdvanced Routing Package§r to allow more complex automation of your components!

The Nanopart Splitter allows splitting, merging and filtering of your components between different colored VCI and VCO hatches. In the configuration GUI, you can define rules such as:
- Merging any colors of your choice into one color
- Evenly splitting inputs from one color into many output colors
- Filtering specific components from one color to another
and many more!

Additionally, if you purchase the Premium Package, you gain access to the Splitter Redstone Input hatch, allowing for fine-grained redstone control of your routing. Each redstone hatch has a "channel" setting, which can then be configured in a rule for it to use that specific hatch's redstone signal.
